content:
sarah: Customer reports 401s only after building their server with esbuild+pnpm. Local dev run works. Build -> bundle -> run hits 401 on /v1/generate.
ben: share minimal repro + package.json pls
sarah: repro steps:
```
pnpm i
pnpm build
node ./dist/server.js # OK
esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=bundle.js
node bundle.js # 401
```

sarah: customer package.json snippet:
```
{"dependencies":{"@redwood/inference":"^2.4.0","node-fetch":"2.6.7"}}
```

sarah: SDK package.json exports:
```
"exports":{
  \".\":{\"import\":\"./dist/index.mjs\",\"require\":\"./dist/index.cjs\"},
  \"./package.json\":\"./package.json\"
}
```

alex: likely duplication: bundler + pnpm hoisting sometimes include both import+require entrypoints which can inline two copies of the SDK runtime. If the two runtimes differ in fetch wrapper behavior, auth can be dropped in one.

sarah: bundle analysis shows two auth functions:
```
function fetchWithAuth(req){ /* preserves Authorization */ }
function fetchEdgeShim(req){ /* strips Authorization */ }
```

eng-support: confirm gateway logs? is header missing or invalid key?
sarah: gateway shows missing Authorization on requests from bundled artifact; dev runs include header.

ben: try aliasing the sdk to a single entry in esbuild to force one artifact: --alias:@redwood/inference=./node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/index.mjs

sarah: alias fixed it locally — bundle now sends Authorization and 401 disappears. Workaround validated with customer.

alex: long-term fix: publish SDK so import+require point to the same file runtime. Options: ship unified ESM entry and map both import/require to it, or ensure both exports reference same compiled artifact.

maria: will prototype change. Concern: are typings reachable for both CJS/ESM if we unify?
alex: yes — ship single .d.ts and set \"types\" in package.json.

eng-platform: priority high (prod 401 for customers). Next steps:
- eng-sdk: make patch that unifies runtime exports and adds bundling test (esbuild+pnpm) in CI
- docs: add bundler compatibility guide and alias recipe
- cs: provide customer temporary workaround and pinned version option

ben: I opened INF-5243 and assigned to @alex and @maria. Please attach repro repo link.
sarah: repro added: https://github.com/redwood-repros/ts-bundle-auth-401 (private)

maria: aiming for patch 2.4.1 today. Will add an esbuild+pnpm bundling test and release if green. :rocket:

ben: note to docs/changelog: mention bundler compatibility note.

eng-platform: deploy-bot: queued branch inf-5243 -> staging

deploy-bot: deploy queued

sarah: customer informed of workaround (esbuild alias or pin to 2.3.x). Will verify once 2.4.1 published and confirm closure.
